title: Deep learning finds multimetallic single-atom catalysts across material families
summary: The Crossbreeding Neural Network (CBNN), trained jointly on carbon-supported single-atom catalysts and perovskite oxides, screened 8,008 candidates. Its top W-Mo-Ru-Rh design on a perovskite support outperformed the comparison catalysts in synthesis and electrochemical tests, and the 12 predicted catalysts were ranked in line with experiment. Evidence caveat: the figures come from institutional coverage and the Nature Materials DOI from a secondary source; overpotential values were not checked.
organization: Institute for Basic Science (IBS) Center for Nanoparticle Research; Seoul National University
